title: Metabolism Light Fixture Node And Handle Kind Ids
description: Add nodeKind to every wip.initialKit.types.items entry and handleKind to every port (families[].ports.items and connector port refs) in assets/fixtures/metabolism.kit.light.compose.json so board semantic kinds can bind to kit fixtures.
summary: Added stable board-aligned semantic ids: every wip.initialKit type has nodeKind compose.metabolism.light.node.<id>; every family port and every connector port ref has handleKind compose.metabolism.light.handle.<portId>. Neo4j seed persists Type.nodeKind and Port.handleKind. Rust contract test metabolism_light_fixture_kinds_for_types_and_ports plus ticket-local apply-node-handle-kinds.mjs for regeneration.
